legend: Bone marrow smears showing multilineage dysplasia with a micromegakaryocyte and hypogranulated white precursors (<<36458>>), binucleated megakaryocytes (<<36455>>), and megakaryocytes with multiple nuclei (<<36457>>). Iron overload and increased erythropoiesis with megaloblastic changes are seen (<<36454>>).
